title: Nanaimo colour analysis in a salon: clarify what the hour includes

description: Ask what a Nanaimo salon-based colour consultation includes, from palette guidance to jewellery. Separate hair treatments and compare useful app previews.

sections.title: Separate personal colour guidance from a salon hair service
sections.html:
Nanaimo readers may encounter colour analysis within a hair-salon setting. That can make it easy to connect palette ideas with a future hair discussion, but it does not mean that the analysis fee includes colouring or styling. Ask for the scope of each appointment separately.

Colours with Krysta

The provider’s indexed service page describes a 60-minute consultation using 16 seasonal categories, with clothing, makeup and jewellery guidance at KG Hair Salon. The colour-analyst directory also identifies Krysta Knott in Nanaimo. A current booking fee was not verified.

View the provider’s service information ↗

sections.title: Ask how the 16 categories become practical advice
sections.html:
If hair is your main reason for booking, bring a picture of your current colour and a few examples you like. Ask whether the analysis also covers clothing neutrals and makeup, what reference you keep, and whether the hair consultation needs another slot. A palette category should be the beginning of a conversation about the look you want.

  • Is the consultation separate from hair colouring and styling?
  • What palette or written reference will I receive?

sections.title: Bring your existing jewellery into the discussion
sections.html: Use a preview to compare broad directions before making a salon decision, then let the stylist assess the real hair and maintenance requirements. For your wardrobe, start with a familiar outfit and one alternative near-face colour. Stylist AI can keep that exploration on your phone while you decide whether hands-on guidance would be helpful.

sections.title: A preview is useful before a separate salon decision
sections.html:
The number of categories does not tell you how much time you will have for questions or which materials you leave with. Ask whether the appointment can address the two decisions most relevant to you—for example, clothing neutrals and jewellery—and whether makeup advice is a discussion, application or lesson.

Stylist AI offers photo-based exploration of seasonal colours, outfits, hair and makeup. Its introduction starts with your selfie; camera colour comparison can help you consider clothing later. Use the app to narrow the direction you like, then take an actual treatment question to the salon. The professional consultation adds live explanation and physical comparisons, while the app gives you tools to revisit independently.

editorial.leadHtml:
Does the colour analysis include a hair treatment?

The reviewed description establishes a consultation with clothing, makeup and jewellery guidance. A treatment should be quoted separately unless the provider explicitly includes it.

Is the current fee confirmed?

No. The indexed service description and analyst directory support the lead; request a current booking quote directly.
